description.en:
Deusto Entrepreneurship: sharing business knowledge, promoted by the Deusto Entrepreneurship Center at the University of Deusto, aims to update and connect knowledge of entrepreneurs, researchers and professionals on entrepreneurship and business.

Deusto Entrepreneurship works with GNOSS software (RIAM Intelearning Lab). RIAM is a company that develops semantic technology for the creation of specialized networks and linked markets. Deusto Entrepreneurship is a source of information and opinion especially recommended for people who visualize an opportunity and need inspiration, approach and support to launch a business. It offers a selection of 257 resources on entrepreneurship (September 2012).
